```{r setup}
if(!require(readr)){install.packages('readr')}
library(readr)
if(!require(tidyverse)){install.packages('tidyverse')}
library(tidyverse) 

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")
setwd("/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")

#Data exported with values (not labels) and all variables assigned character class for later conversion to correct class; first two rows with item labeling manually removed prior to import

phase2_round1_withduplicate <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round1_withduplicate.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) 

phase2_round1_deduplicated <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round1_deduplicated.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

phase2_round2 <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round2.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r initial cleaning}

#Add aim2r1_expert_group column to Phase 2 Round 2 data (will need to do the same for Round 3)
phase2_round2 <- phase2_round2 %>%
  left_join(
    phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
      select(Participant_ID, aim2r1_expert_group),
    by = "Participant_ID"
  )

#Probably no need to merge Phase 1 and Phase 2 data (demographics should be reported seperately)

#For demographics, use phase2_round1_deduplicated (this is the main demographics to report in-text divided by participant group and overall; probably report phase 1 demographics seperately in a supplement)
```

```{r transforming data}
#Create categorical variables
phase2_round1_withduplicate <- phase2_round1_withduplicate %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(contains("aim2r1_expert_group"),
      contains("aim2r1_prvntion_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ident_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ir_"),
      contains("aim2r1_treatmnt_"),
      contains("aim2r1_psorsrpt_")),
    as.factor))

phase2_round1_deduplicated <- phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(contains("aim2r1_expert_group"),
      contains("aim2r1_prvntion_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ident_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ir_"),
      contains("aim2r1_treatmnt_"),
      contains("aim2r1_psorsrpt_")),
    as.factor))

#NOTE: Worrying about demographics etc later, just focusing now on what needs to be cleaned for narrowing bridge items for rounds 2 and 3
```
